modelId.description: Select the model containing the database

queryPresentations.description: An array of queryPresentation objects, each representing a query in the document's workbook

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Omni document (workbook) under a given model, optionally seeding it with query presentations. Use to programmatically provision a document for analysis or dashboards. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate document even with identical inputs.

createASchedule.name: createASchedule
createASchedule.description: Creates a scheduled task for a dashboard with support for email, SFTP, and webhook destinations

identifier.description: The string after /dashboards is the dashboards ID; for example: https://blobsrus.omniapp.co/dashboards/12db1a0a

schedule.description: Cron expression for the schedule (e.g., "0 9 ? * * *" for 9 AM UTC daily) https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-scheduled-rule-pattern.html

destinationType.description: Type of destination for the schedule

url.description: Webhook URL (required when destinationType is webhook)

recipients.description: Email recipients (required when destinationType is email)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a scheduled delivery for an Omni dashboard, sending output on a cron-defined cadence to one of three destination types (email, webhook, or SFTP) in a chosen format. Use to automate recurring report delivery. The required destination type determines which optional fields apply (e.g. recipients for email, url for webhook). Not idempotent: each call creates a new schedule even with identical inputs.

deleteADocument.name: deleteADocument
deleteADocument.description: Deletes the specified document and places it in the Trash

aiMetadata.description: Deletes an Omni document by its ID, moving it to the Trash. Use to remove a document the agent has located. Effectively idempotent: once the document is trashed, repeating the call with the same ID has no further effect (subsequent calls may error if the ID no longer resolves).

deleteASchedule.name: deleteASchedule
deleteASchedule.description: Deletes a schedule using its UUID

aiMetadata.description: Deletes an Omni dashboard schedule by its UUID. Use to stop a recurring delivery the agent has identified. Effectively idempotent: once removed, repeating the call with the same UUID has no further effect.

editSchedule.name: editSchedule
editSchedule.description: Updates a scheduled task. Only properties included will be updated

schedule.description: Cron expression for the schedule (e.g., "0 9 ? * * *" for 9 AM UTC daily) https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-scheduled-rule-pattern.html

destinationType.description: Type of destination for the schedule

url.description: Webhook URL (required when destinationType is webhook)

recipients.description: Email recipients (required when destinationType is email)

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Omni dashboard schedule, identified by its UUID, replacing its cadence, format, and destination settings. Use to modify a recurring delivery the agent has located rather than recreating it. Idempotent: applying the same values to the same schedule yields the same end state.

generateQuery.name: generateQuery
generateQuery.description: Transforms a natural language description into a structured Omni query

modelId.description: Select the model containing the database

prompt.description: The natural language description of the query you want to generate (e.g., "Show me all users who signed up in the last month")

currentTopicName.description: The name of the topic to use as context for the query generation

branchId.description: The ID of the model branch to use for query generation. If not provided, the main branch will be used

contextQuery.description: The query object to provide as context. This can be used to reference previous queries or provide additional context for the generation

structured.description: When enabled, the API will return a more strictly structured query format

aiMetadata.description: Generates a structured Omni query object from a natural-language prompt against a given model, optionally guided by a topic, model branch, or a context query, and can emit a more strictly structured format. Use to translate a plain-English analytics request into a runnable query (then pass the result to Run query). Not idempotent: AI generation may return different output across calls for the same prompt.

moveDocument.name: moveDocument
moveDocument.description: Moves a document to a new folder or to the root level

folderPath.description: The path of the destination folder. Use null to move the document to the root level (no folder)

scope.description: Optional sharing scope for the document. If not provided, the scope will be computed

aiMetadata.description: Moves an Omni document to a target folder path, or to the root level when the path is set to "null". Optionally sets the sharing scope (organization or restricted). Use to reorganize where a document lives. Idempotent: moving a document to the same destination repeatedly yields the same placement.

runQuery.name: runQuery
runQuery.description: Runs a query and returns the results as base64 encoded Apache Arrow table or in specified format

query.description: A JSON object representing the query to be run. You can retrieve a query's JSON object from an Omni workbook by opening the Inspector panel (Option + 9 on Mac, Alt + 9 on Windows) and copying the Query structure

limit.description: Number of rows to be returned (defaults to 1000). Set to null for unlimited results

cache.description: Optional cache policy to control how query caching behaves

formatResults.description: Apply formatting to numeric and currency values (currency symbols and thousand separators)

resultType.description: Specifies the format of query results. If omitted, returns base64 encoded Apache Arrow format

planOnly.description: If enabled, returns the query execution plan without running the query

userId.description: Optional UUID to run the query as a specific user

aiMetadata.description: Executes an Omni query (passed as a JSON query object) and returns the result rows, in base64 Apache Arrow by default or in CSV/JSON/XLSX when a result type is set; can instead return only the execution plan without running. Use to read data from Omni for analysis or downstream steps. Read-only and idempotent: it fetches data and does not mutate state. Requires a valid query JSON object (obtainable from an Omni workbook Inspector panel).

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

pt.Creates a scheduled task for a dashboard: Cria uma tarefa programada para um painel com suporte para e-mails, SFTP e destinos de webhook
pt.Deletes the specified document and place: Exclui o documento especificado e o coloca na Lixeira
pt.Deletes a schedule using its UUID: Exclui um agendamento usando seu UUID
pt.Updates a scheduled task. Only propertie: Atualiza uma tarefa programada. Somente as propriedades incluídas serão atualizadas
pt.Transforms a natural language descriptio: Transforma uma descrição de linguagem natural em uma consulta Omni estruturada
pt.Moves a document to a new folder or to t: Move um documento para uma nova pasta ou para o nível raiz
pt.Runs a query and returns the results as: Executa uma consulta e retorna os resultados como base64 codificado na tabela Apache Arrow ou no formato especificado
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.Select the model containing the database: Selecione o modelo que contém o banco de dados
pt.An array of queryPresentation objects, e: Um array de objetos de consulta de apresentação, cada um representando uma consulta na pasta de trabalho do documento
pt.The string after /dashboards is the das: A string após /dashboards é o ID dos painéis; por exemplo: https://blobsrus.omniapp.co/dashboards/12db1a0a
pt.Cron expression for the schedule (e.g.,: Expressão Cron para o agendamento (por exemplo, "0 9 ? * * *" para 9 AM UTC diariamente) https://docs.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-scheduled-rule-pattern.html
pt.Timezone for the schedule (e.g., \"UTC\": Fuso horário para o cronograma (por exemplo, "UTC", "América/New_York") Referência: https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb-2021a/zone1970.tab

pt.Type of destination for the schedule: Tipo de destino para o agendamento

pt.Email recipients (required when destinat: Destinatários de e-mail (necessário quando o tipo de destino é e-mail)
pt.Subject line for email delivery: Linha de assunto para entrega de e-mail
pt.Paper format for PDF output: Formato de papel para saída de PDF
pt.Paper orientation for PDF output: Orientação de papel para saída de PDF
pt.The natural language description of the: A descrição do idioma natural da consulta que você deseja gerar (por exemplo, "Mostre-me todos os usuários que se inscreveram no mês passado")
pt.The name of the topic to use as context: O nome do tópico a ser usado como contexto para a geração de consultas

O objeto de consulta para fornecer como contexto. Isto pode ser usado para fazer referência a consultas anteriores ou fornecer um contexto adicional para a geração
pt.When enabled, the API will return a more: Quando habilitada, a API retornará um formato de consulta mais estritamente estruturado

Escopo de compartilhamento opcional para o documento. Se não fornecido, o escopo será calculado
pt.A JSON object representing the query to: Um objeto JSON representando a consulta a ser executada. Você pode recuperar o objeto JSON de uma consulta de um livro de trabalho Omni abrindo o painel de Inspetores (Opção + 9 em Mac, Alt + 9 no Windows) e copiar a estrutura de consulta
